title: Jalen Brunson & KATSEYE on ‘SNL’: Here’s Where to Watch the Season 52 Premiere Live Online for Free
summary: Livestream the NY Knicks superstar and global pop girl group for season premiere of Saturday Night Live on Sept. 26 — watch live online for free.
contentText:

On Saturday (Sept. 26), Saturday Night Live returns with the premiere episode of season 52 . The sketch comedy show taps New York Knicks superstar and NBA Finals MVP, Jalen Brunson to host, while pop girl group KATSEYE serves as musical guest .

Get DirecTV 5-Day Free Trial

Brunson and KATSEYE are both making their SNL debuts. However, only four of the six members of KATSEYE — Daniela Avanzini, Lara Raj, Megan Skiendiel and Yoonchae Jeung — are expected to perform during the show.

How to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Sept. 26

- Network: NBC

- Host, Musical Guest: Jalen Brunson & KATSEYE

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Peacock

When Does ‘Saturday Night Live’ Start ?

SNL premieres on Saturday (Sept. 26), with a start time of 11:30 p.m. ET/PT.

What TV Network Features ‘Saturday Night Live’?

In 2026, SNL broadcasts on TV on NBC. Meanwhile, the variety sketch show is available to livestream on Peacock.

Who’s Appearing on ‘Saturday Night Live’ Tonight?

SNL is known for celebrity cameos during the show, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Since Jalen Brunson is hosting, it’s expected that other players from the New York Knicks would also appear, like Josh Hart, Karl-Anthony Towns, OG Anunoby, Mikal Bridges, Jose Alvarado and more.

Other artists who have been known to appear at SNL in the past, include Timothée Chalamet, Ben Stiller, Alec Baldwin, Mariska Hargitay, Meryl Streep, Harry Styles and others.

Where to Watch ‘Saturday Night Live’ Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch SNL online, if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, like Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , also offer free trials, so you can watch for free.
